Deck name: Gangrel Things
Author: Noora Hirvonen
Description: Thank you Aapo Järvelin (Khormag) for handing me the predecessor of this deck in the after-games of a tournament he organized in Joensuu a couple of years back, the deck is super fun to play. I played versions of it quite a lot in 2022, and last months I have had a feeling it could do well in the grindy Stockholm meta with its fast and plentiful actions and reactions. This iteration though I feel like I made slightly worse by adding some random cards outside of the core mechanic of Computer hacking, Thing and Earth meld, but it did hold itself together this time.
Score: R1-1gw3 R2-0,5vp R-0 F-1,5vp

Messages.Author: Thalco
Messages.Body:
is andre actually good in the deck? other than his artwork
i always feel like the crypt needs more animalism and he's just another guy without it. i ran joseph fincher in mine at the weekend and he was pretty good. I happened to open with all 3 of my vampires without animalism and it really hurt. Had a stealth bleed deck on my heels and really needed to play deep ecology for intercept.

. Prince of Liverpool and UK NC

Messages.Author: Lenny
Messages.Body:
I think he is amazing for hand management and this is a weenie PRO deck with fortitude, so his only down side is being one gen too big. The old 2-3 crypt does the job as well, and if it ran animalism it would be a different deck. (I actually use the new crypt mostly to contest new baron decks, and it has been so far a great strategy.)
